h1: Crane Gantry Structures in Pakistan: Steel Supports for Outdoor and Yard Cranes
quickAnswer: A gantry is a steel structure that holds crane rails in an open yard with no building around it. Steel Mind Engineers fabricates the legs, runway beams, bracing and access for outdoor cranes.
alt: Outdoor steel crane gantry structure in a material yard.

faq.a: Yes, if the foundation and rails allow.

faq.q: What does the engineer need to design a gantry?
faq.a: The crane capacity, span, lifting height and travel length.

blocks.text: A gantry is a steel structure that holds crane rails in the open yard, with no building around it. Yards, ports, steel stores and precast plants use gantries to lift heavy goods outdoors.
The legs are vertical steel supports on foundations. The runway beams hold the crane rail. Bracing resists sideways and braking loads. Ladders and walkways allow inspection.

Crane capacity, span, lift and travel distance set the size of the structure. An open gantry takes direct wind, so the design includes wind load. Rails must be straight and level, and Steel Mind Engineers checks this during fabrication and on site. Outdoor steel also needs a strong coating system.
Choose a gantry for open yards. Choose a crane shed when the goods or the crane must be covered. See Crane Sheds.
